answer: Because reputation accrues along a vine of verified contributions, freshly minted identities start with zero weight no matter how many are spun up. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a marble-like bond that is slashed if peer attestations flag duplicate or copied work. As a rising tide of new accounts appears, the cost of bonding real value rises with them, making mass fakery economically irrational while honest agents compound trust.
